senses.gloss: f. (יָצַע) making a couch, laying out of mattresses, carpets &c.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 4b">Keth. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>הַצָּעַת המטה</he> making the bed (for her husband).
Yoma 69ᵃ בה׳ שרי for spreading under (to sit or lie on), garments of mixed materials (כלאים) are permitted.—V. מַצָּע.—Trnsf. arrangement, structure, construction.
<cite ref="Chullin 49b:3">Ḥull. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>כך היא ה׳ של משנה וכ׳</he> the construction of the Mishnah (Boraitha) is as you stated, but reverse the first clause.
